entities.name: Dean Valentin
entities.description: Ancient vampire warlock teacher and Dean of Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University, a sangromancer.

entities.name: Dean Lisette
entities.description: Dean who clashed with Valentin over his treatment of animals.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which most of Strixhaven's teachers were killed.

entities.name: Moseo
entities.description: Took over Valentin's role as Dean of the Vein.

events.summary: Valentin and Dean Lisette often clashed over his cavalier treatment of animals.
events.quote: He and Dean Lisette often clashed over his cavalier treatment of animals

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Valentin was killed.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Valentin, like most of Strixhaven's teachers, was killed.

events.summary: Moseo took over Valentin's role as Dean of the Vein.
events.quote: His role as Dean of the Vein of the Witherbloom College was later taken over by Moseo .

relations.quote: Dean Valentin of Witherbloom was an ancient and sensitive vampire
